entities.summary: Eduard von Steinle was a painter and a printmaker. He was born in 1810 in Vienna, Austria and died in 1889 in Frankfurt, Germany. He spent 1828-33 in Rome with similar artists from the Nazarene school before returning to Vienna in 1873. Frederic Leighton studied under him.
